A <TEXTITOPEN_0001>valuation ring<TEXTITCLOSE_0001> is a local domain maximal among the relation
of domination in its fraction field, see
Algebra, Definition <REF_0001>.
Hence the spectrum of a valuation ring has a unique generic point
<MATH_0001> and a unique closed point <MATH_0002>, and of course we have the
specialization <MATH_0003>.
The significance of valuation rings is that any specialization of
points in any scheme is the image of <MATH_0004>
under some morphism from the spectrum of some valuation ring.
